item.title: Verbose beta 269
item.description:
What's new, with pictures

Mac

  • What's new opens by itself after bigger updates, once. Continue closes it, and See every update opens the full list. It comes back only for the next bigger update.
  • Each change has its own picture and headline, in the pop-up and in What's new.
  • Smaller updates keep the note on Home, as before.

Release notes on GitHub
